title: Unofficial Raider 2025
author: Nick S.
desc:
All information was taken from Bald Omni Man's video and his spreadsheet. I highly recommend you watch the video and view the spreadsheet, which you can find below. All credit to BOM. Go subscribe to his channel! If requested or an official version of Raider 2025 gets released, I will unpublish this.

Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12ziYnxGQBLnWyJPk2sGYojkrFvwjsEjnhcpKJI8jLuE/edit?usp=sharing

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_bVp_UMoUrw

ex.note: For backdown sets, use 85% of your first set weight.
Vertical Pull of choice. 5-10+ (take more than 10 reps on last set if possible).
Horizontal Row of Choice. 8-12+ (take more than 12 reps on your last set if possible).

ss.note: 12 rep max on first set, do two thirds the reps on sets 2 and 3 (beat your reps on sets 2 and 3 each week, add weight once all 3 sets match your week 1 amrap)
Supinated Bicep Exercise of Choice (you can superset this with triceps)

ex.note: Side Delt Isolation of Choice. 12 rep max on first set, do two thirds the reps on sets 2 and 3 (beat your reps on sets 2 and 3 each week, add weight once all 3 sets match your week 1 amrap)
Calisthenics Chest Press of Choice. 15-20+ (Triple Progression). Triple progression: add reps (15→20), then sets, then difficulty. Reset reps when advancing.
Conventional, Sumo, or Trap Bar Deadlift (limit rest pauses to no more than 1, and for no more than 1 breath). Use 85% of your first set for backdown sets.
10 - 15 (increase in load when all sets are done with around 15 reps +/- 1 rep). Myrorep match sets 2/3 (match top set reps as closely as possible).
Adductor Isolation of Choice.

ss.note: Hamstring Curl of Choice (superset these with the quad unilateral exercise)
Unilateral Quad Exercise of Choice.

ex.note: Incline Press OR Overhead Press of Choice OR Horizontal Press of Choice. Use 85% of first set for backdown sets.
Vertical OR Horizontal Pull Of Choice (pick a different exercise that you didn't use on upper 1). 8-12 (take more than 12 reps on your last set if possible)
2-3 min cluster set (do a hard but not all out set of 10, then rest a few breaths, hit 2-3 reps, rinse and repeat until 2-3 minutes have elapsed).
